ops.text: Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, TrueLink shall (a) provide transition assistance for up to six (6) months at TrueLink's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination, return to Client all Client data in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Client in writing.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 14 ends the Hosting and Support Services without any exit mechanic, so we have added our standard transition clause: six months of transition assistance at TrueLink's then-current rates, return of our data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days of expiration or termination, and certified deletion thereafter. The return deadline runs from expiration or termination rather than from a later request so the data comes back unconditionally.
proposal.summary: Insert preferred transition assistance, 30-day data return in standard machine-readable format and certified deletion after Section 14
